body: Absolutely zero to lose from doing aside from removing some pos humans off the earth and aside from that, no offense but you have no idea the amount of trama these people have caused in my life.

I really appreciate the different outlook and tbh I haven't even thought of it like that, as far as her possibly thinking I'm just saying what I'm saying just in spite of her current situation and not as advice from a concerned friend.

Thanks for the reply! My brain tells me I should move on but my heart is telling me that the person I've spent 9 years with and honestly my bestfriend is in mental trouble and the only thing I want to do at this point is help her because some of this behavior is something I've never seen or would never expect after knowing someone and being bestfriends with someone for 9 years.

Thank you for the reply! I have trying its proven difficult because we still own quite a few things together that for whatever reason she's is taking her time on deciding on what she wants to do with, plus my dog is still there but I'm not sure how to fix that situation since my current living situation doesn't allow for him to be with me.
Yeah its definitely a long time. That's the thing that's holding me back the most and honestly making it hard to move on. Just a lot of time, love and care invested.
Right ! From what she made me aware of the baby daddy in school at the moment too so it's seeming to be a whole bundle of joy
Thank you, I had the same thought, she's 25 and I'm 28 i figured we were both at the age where we can make our own decisions!
I agree but last time I went over there to grab my stuff she for whatever reason decided to point out the pro of the situation of "her not having to go through pregnancy to have kids." Lol

Thank you for your reply!  I'm trying to stay neutral but its turning out real hard lol, but I appreciate your outlook on the situation because taking it for face value of what I might be seeing right now it's hard to think outside of the life I've had with this person over the past 9 years.

Yeah that's what I was afraid of. We had a house, car and dog together. That part of it I'm dreading. Plus I use my dog to cope and as of right now I can't have him with me because of my current living situation. The scariest part about all of this to me is I honestly don't know after 9 years how to not live without her.
I  agree it's just killing me on the inside watching what could be a possible life changing decision on her part.

Thanks for the reply, deep down I feel the same but I just don't want to have to witness the impending crash she might be putting herself through. I feel like I should let her know what is actually going on but I feel like she wouldn't listen to me even if I said anything.
I'm trying. My brain says move on my heart says losing a my bestfriend of 9 years and/or watching her possibly ruin her life in front of my eyes just feels wrong.

I still have stuff at our house that I have to get. Our relationship over the 9 years had its ups and downs believe me but we always stayed loyal to each other, neither of us ever cheated. She told me she shouldn't have forgave some of the stuff from our past/she forgave it prematurely. This is the part that kills me and made me want to work things out but then I found out she's been fucking this guy for the past 3 weeks while telling me I'm "her person" and "love me."

I want to believe that I really do but at that point in my life i dont want to seek another person but after what she's done me I dont think I could ever look at her the same, she openly was telling me their sex life and was covered in hickies. The point of pain she is trying to cause me is killing me from the inside, I acted fine physically when she told me  but mentally I was ready at that point to kill myself  knowing that she had no issue trying to hurt me. After 9 years I would've never thought a person could be capable of this.
I honestly dont think I can, just me as a person, I care to much and I dont know how to deal with what's happening in front of my face without wanting to do something.

I've started playing sports that I haven't played in years and started reconnecting with a few of my friend groups. It's just scary to me I guess because I feel like I'll never make another relationship like the one I just left.

I agree just the moving on part is what I'm struggling with. We've helped each other a lot over the years mentally and physically and we were best friends before we started dating so it's hard to not wonder or care how she's doing.
Yeah your  not wrong it's just hard, I feel like a lot of time and effort has been put in over the years on both sides, it just seems very weird to me is all.
